title: What changed since last week?

scenes.heading: The training cluster changed
scenes.sub: Start from the last known good snapshot
voice: Last week the training cluster behaved as expected. Today it does not.
A saved snapshot gives the on-call engineer a baseline instead of a guess.

scenes.heading: Capture a fresh observation
voice: Check that the kubeconfig points to the same cluster, then take a fresh snapshot.
Pass the saved baseline and the new target into AICR diff.

scenes.heading: Find the changed reading
voice: The report shows earlier and current values together.
In this example, a kernel version changed, so the engineer can investigate that reading and see any added or removed entries.

scenes.heading: Surface drift in CI
scenes.sub: Decide when drift should interrupt the job
scenes.result: Nonzero exit when drift is detected
voice: A pipeline can save the structured diff and use the fail on drift flag.
That makes drift interrupt the job while preserving the report for investigation.

payoff: Use a saved baseline and fresh snapshot to identify one changed kernel reading and flag drift in CI.
